articles.title: Bitcoin Depot, North America's largest bitcoin ATM operator, files for bankruptcy
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Depot, the largest bitcoin ATM operator in North America and publicly listed on Nasdaq, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

articles.title: Bitcoin Depot stock crashes 71% premarket after Chapter 11 filing
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Depot files for Chapter 11 in Texas, plans asset sale and wind-down as regulatory pressure forces shutdown of its Bitcoin ATM network.

articles.title: Crypto ATM Operator Bitcoin Depot Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
articles.snippet: North America's largest Bitcoin ATM operator cited a hostile regulatory environment and an 'unsustainable' business model.
